RULE-1.gloss: If someone bought 3 shorts and the price per shorts is 1650, then the subtotal for shorts is 4950
RULE-1.formula: ∀x((Bought(x, shorts, n_3) ∧ Price(shorts, n_1650)) → Subtotal(x, shorts, n_4950))

RULE-2.gloss: If someone bought 3 pants and the price per pants is 2250, then the subtotal for pants is 6750
RULE-2.formula: ∀x((Bought(x, pants, n_3) ∧ Price(pants, n_2250)) → Subtotal(x, pants, n_6750))

RULE-3.gloss: If someone bought 3 shoes and the price per shoes is 4200, then the subtotal for shoes is 12600
RULE-3.formula: ∀x((Bought(x, shoes, n_3) ∧ Price(shoes, n_4200)) → Subtotal(x, shoes, n_12600))

RULE-4.gloss: If Subtotal(x, shorts, 4950) ∧ Subtotal(x, pants, 6750) ∧ Subtotal(x, shoes, 12600) then TotalSpent(x, 24300)
RULE-4.formula: ∀x((Subtotal(x, shorts, n_4950) ∧ Subtotal(x, pants, n_6750) ∧ Subtotal(x, shoes, n_12600)) → TotalSpent(x, n_24300))
